[LGRA.10.1.1] **`log_level` is matched case-insensitively** —
`log info "x"`, `log INFO "x"`, and `log Info "x"` are all
valid and equivalent. The compiler normalises the value to
upper-case in the lowered `log` action. Unknown
names produce a compile error. The five levels mirror Python's
`logging` module.
